description: Four units whose lossless channel set has a source resolution of 24 bits stored in 16, so it is rejected, and the DTS:X word after the band data, which is not looked for.
findings: source resolution of 24 bits is more than its storage width of 16 bits

crosscheck.decode_error: Invalid PCM bit resolution for XLL channel set

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame (dca_xll.c), which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder refuses a resolution beyond the width in parse_sub_headers, before it looks for the DTS:X word (dca_xll.c: 'Invalid PCM bit resolution for XLL channel set'); MediaInfo 24.01 would still read the word
skip.ffprobe_channels: ffmpeg cannot decode the lossless layer, so it reports the core's two channels and their layout
